target.title: Fix Telegram reply ordering for active topic runs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Telegram forum/topic messages can arrive while an earlier topic reply is still owed. The current behaviour can treat later same-topic prompts as active-run continuation too early, creating visible ack/reaction/typing confusion and allowing later prompts to enter the active reply context instead of staying as separate owed replies.

This PR keeps ordinary later topic prompts separate unless they are explicit continuations, suppresses queued visible ack cues while an earlier topic reply is active, and routes active same-session follow-up text through reply steering while keeping commands separate.

## Evidence
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.
- `pnpm exec oxlint` passed on touched Telegram/auto-reply source and test files.
- `pnpm check:test-types` passed after the latest reply-fence test payload typing fix.
- `pnpm exec vitest run extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-context.typing.test.ts` passed 7 tests after the latest reply-fence test payload typing fix.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.reply-dispatch.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/reply-run-registry.test.ts` passed 292 tests.
- Focused Telegram bot continuation/follow-up tests passed.
- A broader Telegram bot suite still has one failure in `does not retry plugin-owned callback text skipped by inbound policy`; I reproduced the same failure on clean `origin/main`, so it is pre-existing and unrelated to this PR.

## Summary
- Keep new Telegram topic prompts queued as separate owed replies unless they are explicit continuations of the active run.
- Suppress queued Telegram ack cues while an earlier topic reply is still active.
- Route active same-session follow-up text through reply steering while keeping commands separate.

Supersedes auto-closed PR #101320, which was closed only because the author account was over the active PR cap.
